mapper.select: SELECT equipment_id, user_id, network_type, equipment_type, model_name, serial_number, seq, status, acquisition_cost, acquisition_date, remark FROM TB_EQUIPMENT WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY SEQ

SELECT TU.ORG_NAME, TU.USER_NAME, TU.USER_ID, TE.NETWORK_TYPE, TE.EQUIPMENT_TYPE, TE.SERIAL_NUMBER, TE.MODEL_NAME, TE.ACQUISITION_COST, TE.ACQUISITION_DATE, TE.STATUS, TE.REMARK FROM TB_USER TU, TB_EQUIPMENT TE WHERE TU.USER_ID = TE.USER_ID ORDER BY ORG_NAME, USER_NAME, SEQ
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_EQUIPMENT ( equipment_id, user_id, network_type, equipment_type, model_name, serial_number, seq, status, acquisition_cost, acquisition_date, remark ) SELECT #{equipmentId}, #{userId}, #{networkType}, #{equipmentType}, #{modelName}, #{serialNumber}, COALESCE(MAX(SEQ), 0) + 1, #{status}, #{acquisitionCost}, #{acquisitionDate}, #{remark} FROM TB_EQUIPMENT WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_EQUIPMENT SET equipment_type = #{equipmentType}, network_type = #{networkType}, model_name = #{modelName}, serial_number = #{serialNumber}, status = #{status}, acquisition_cost = #{acquisitionCost}, acquisition_date = #{acquisitionDate}, remark = #{remark}, update_date = NOW() WHERE equipment_id = #{equipmentId}
